instruction: I ordered a drone on amazon on my mother's birthday last year. How much does it cost now, ignoring tax and delivery fees?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are made (evaluation requires no model changes). Flow: get passwords -> phone login -> search contacts with relationship 'mother' to learn her birthday -> amazon login -> list orders and pick the one placed on that month/day in 2022 -> show that order to get the drone product id -> show product to read its current price -> complete_task with that price as the answer. Static facts in :init (birthday-of, ordered-on, order-contains, product-price) encode database structure the agent discovers at runtime; knowledge predicates found-birthday, known-id, found-price gate the downstream lookups. supervisor-complete-task carries the price as the API answer and the product as an extra record parameter so its precondition stays ground.
